title: LongWalk
author: ProtossProbe
description:
Suddenly framed for a crime you didn't commit, you're forced to abandon your plans and flee, horseless, into the forest. Seems you have no choice now but to set out to clear your name.

It's going to be a long walk.

Gameplay elements include:

-turn-based combat
-inventory system/enemy loot
-minor RPG elements
-companion NPCs whose relationships with you may change through your interactions
-non-linear story (decisions create subtle changes in story)
